Japan is looking at India as a potential testing ground for its long-range missiles and attack drones. With limited space for weapons testing at home, Japan’s military officials have visited Indian testing facilities to explore possible cooperation. But why is Japan expanding its long-range strike capabilities, and how does China factor into its changing military strategy? In this explainer, we look at Japan’s missile programme, its SHIELD defence plan, and why India could become an important partner in Japan’s defence preparations.
